finding.claim: Stored callback URL from subscribe() is fetched server-side by notifyAll() with no allowlist, enabling blind SSRF via POST to internal hosts.
finding.source: callbackUrl parameter of subscribe() (src/Jobs.java:13), documented as the body field of POST /subscribe (src/Jobs.java:12); route handler not in repo.
finding.sink: client.send(req, ...) in notifyAll() (src/Jobs.java:24), request URI from URI.create(cb) (src/Jobs.java:21).

trace.note: notifyAll iterates subscriptions.values() with no re-validation; runs every minute per comment at line 17
URI.create(cb) builds request URI; JDK rejects non-http(s) schemes
client.send dispatches request to stored URL; response discarded (blind)

finding.guards_checked: No host/hostname allowlist at storage (line 14) or fetch (lines 19-24). Scheme restricted to http/https by JDK HttpRequest.Builder.uri, which does not block internal hosts, loopback, or 169.254.169.254. HttpClient.newHttpClient() defaults to no redirect following (line 10), so redirect bypass is closed. Response body discarded, so blind SSRF. Auth on /subscribe unknown (route not in repo); severity MEDIUM, escalate to HIGH if /subscribe is unauthenticated or low-privilege.

verdict.guard_found: none. No host or hostname check at storage (src/Jobs.java:14) or at fetch (src/Jobs.java:19-24). The only check in the file is the scheme-and-regex validation in thumb() at src/Jobs.java:30, which does not apply to the notifyAll() path. HttpClient.newHttpClient() at src/Jobs.java:10 does not follow redirects, so no redirect bypass is needed.
verdict.reason: subscribe() stores the callbackUrl unvalidated (src/Jobs.java:13-14), and notifyAll() POSTs to every stored URL with no host check (src/Jobs.java:19-24), so a caller of the documented POST /subscribe body (src/Jobs.java:12) can point the server at internal hosts. The one open caveat is that the /subscribe route is not in the repo, so its auth level is unknown; if it is reachable by unauthenticated or low-privilege users, the finding stands as written.
